question: Does fe1cba85cb12's tooth the_tool_stands (validation_store imports nothing from cairn.devices) narrow to admit a tool its device publishes (charter published_by_device true), so the store can name the host through cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host?

answer: Yes, narrowed to published tools only. Outline 2.3.7.1.5 and 6.6.3.7 route every caller through the host tool the system device publishes, and 17.13.1 (encapsulation_holds) already admits a published tool as the one legal import from another device. fe1c's why (the store stands a rung below the devices, reaching no device code) still holds: two in-tooth checks keep cairn.devices.tester.device and cairn.devices.system_rackmount.rackmount reading as a reach.
